title: isothermEval operation
description: Evaluates a curated adsorption isotherm — the loading of one adsorbate on one adsorbent as a function of pressure and temperature — from the adsorbent record's own parameters. The glass-box surface of what a fixed-bed or TSA unit uses internally, so the isotherm a breakthrough case runs on can be plotted and checked before the bed is ever solved.

adsorbent.title: Adsorbent
adsorbent.description: Resolved by exact name in the assets catalogue (kind adsorbent).

adsorbate.title: Adsorbate
adsorbate.description: The adsorbing species; the adsorbent record must carry parameters for it.

grid.title: Evaluation grid
grid.description: The (T, p) points to evaluate: `{ T ( ... ); p ( ... ); }`, every combination of the two lists. Values are RAW canonical SI (K and Pa) — this is a bench surface, not a case dict, so no unit suffix is applied.

unitTwin.title: Unit to mirror
unitTwin.description: Name of a flowsheet or batch unit whose isotherm settings this evaluation should reproduce exactly — so the plotted curve is provably the one that unit runs on, rather than a second set of numbers that happens to look similar.

output.title: CSV output
output.description: `{ file <name>.csv; }` — where the per-row results are written, relative to the case directory.
